title: Login with valid credentials (no 2FA) lands on dashboard
description: Verifies a user can log in with correct username/password and reach the dashboard when 2FA is not required.

title: Invalid password shows credentials error on login page
description: Verifies an incorrect password prevents login and displays a visible error message.

title: Non-existent user shows invalid credentials error
description: Verifies a non-existent username cannot log in and an error message is shown.

title: Empty username prevents login and shows validation message
description: Verifies the login form blocks submission or shows a visible validation error when username is missing.

title: Empty password prevents login and shows validation message
description: Verifies the login form blocks submission or shows a visible validation error when password is missing.

title: Account lockout after repeated failed login attempts
description: Verifies repeated invalid login attempts result in a visible account locked/temporarily blocked notification.

title: Dashboard loads and shows KPI, charts, and inventory overview
description: Verifies the authenticated user can open the dashboard and see core KPI cards, revenue charts, and inventory status sections.

title: Use dashboard quick action to start creating a sales invoice
description: Verifies the dashboard quick action for creating an invoice redirects to the invoice creation page.

steps.description: Click the "Create Invoice" quick action button

title: Filter dashboard by date range and see updated results
description: Verifies that selecting a date range filter updates the dashboard content for the selected period.

steps.description: Click the dashboard date range filter control
Select "Last 30 days" from the date range dropdown

title: Filter dashboard by a different date range option
description: Verifies the dashboard can switch between date ranges without errors and still shows charts and KPIs.

steps.description: Click the dashboard date range filter control
Select "This month" from the date range dropdown

title: Dashboard shows quick actions area and it is usable
description: Verifies the dashboard quick actions section is visible and at least one quick action is clickable.

steps.description: Click the "Create Invoice" quick action button

title: Dashboard remains stable after changing date range multiple times
description: Verifies changing the date range repeatedly keeps the dashboard usable and charts remain visible.

steps.description: Click the dashboard date range filter control
Select "Last 7 days" from the date range dropdown
Click the dashboard date range filter control
Select "Last 90 days" from the date range dropdown

title: Create a new sales invoice and verify it appears in the invoice list
description: Verifies an authenticated user can create and save a sales invoice and then see it in the invoices list.

steps.description: Click on the "Sales Invoices" link in the navigation menu
Select an existing customer from the Customer dropdown
Click the "Add product" or "Add line item" button
Select an existing product for the new line item
Type "1" into the Quantity field for the line item
Type "10" into the Unit Price field for the line item
Type "0" into the Discount field (if present)
Click the "Back to list" or "Invoices" link
Verify text "Invoice" is visible in the list

title: Search and filter invoices from the invoice list
description: Verifies the invoice list search/filter controls update the visible results.

steps.description: Click on the "Sales Invoices" link in the navigation menu
Verify text "INV" is visible in the results area

title: View invoice details from the invoice list
description: Verifies a user can open an invoice details view from the invoices list.

steps.description: Click on the "Sales Invoices" link in the navigation menu
Click on the first visible invoice row (or its "View" button)

title: Attempt to save invoice without selecting a customer shows validation error
description: Verifies the invoice form blocks saving when Customer is empty and shows a required-field validation message.

steps.description: Click on the "Sales Invoices" link in the navigation menu
Verify text "Customer is required" is visible

title: Attempt to save invoice with insufficient stock shows validation error or warning
description: Verifies the system prevents saving (or clearly warns) when a line item quantity exceeds available stock.

steps.description: Click on the "Sales Invoices" link in the navigation menu
Select an existing customer from the Customer dropdown
Click the "Add product" or "Add line item" button
Select an existing product for the new line item
Type "999999" into the Quantity field for the line item

title: Apply discount and verify totals update before saving
description: Verifies discounts can be applied on the invoice form and the total section reflects the change visibly.

steps.description: Click on the "Sales Invoices" link in the navigation menu
Select an existing customer from the Customer dropdown
Click the "Add product" or "Add line item" button
Select an existing product for the new line item
Type "2" into the Quantity field for the line item
Type "50" into the Unit Price field for the line item
Type "10" into the Discount field (invoice-level or line-level)
Verify text "90" is visible in the total area

title: Autosave indicator appears while editing invoice form (if present)
description: Verifies the invoice form shows a visible autosave status/indicator after making changes.

steps.description: Click on the "Sales Invoices" link in the navigation menu
Select an existing customer from the Customer dropdown
Click the "Add product" or "Add line item" button
Select an existing product for the new line item
Type "1" into the Quantity field for the line item

title: Create a new customer and verify it appears in the customer list
description: Verifies an authenticated user can create a customer record and see it listed in Customer Management.

steps.description: Click the "Customers" link in the Sales module navigation

title: Save a new customer from the create page and verify it returns to the list
description: Verifies saving a valid customer from the create form succeeds and returns to the customer list view.

steps.description: Click the "Customers" link in the Sales module navigation

title: Create customer with name and contact details and confirm it is visible in list
description: Verifies the customer create form accepts valid inputs and the newly created customer is visible in the list after saving.

steps.description: Fill "Test Customer A" into the customer name field

title: Save customer record and verify success by returning to customer list
description: Verifies clicking Save on a completed create-customer form persists the record and returns to the customer list screen.

steps.description: Fill "Test Customer B" into the customer name field

title: View an existing customer's account statement from the customer list
description: Verifies a user can open a customer’s account statement view from the customer list and see statement content.

steps.description: Click the "Customers" link in the Sales module navigation
Click the "View account statement" action for the first customer in the list

title: Check customer credit limit information is visible in customer details/list context
description: Verifies credit limit/status information is shown for a customer where the UI provides it.

steps.description: Click the "Customers" link in the Sales module navigation

title: Validation: invalid email blocks saving a new customer
description: Verifies the create-customer form shows an email format validation error and does not proceed when the email is invalid.

steps.description: Fill "Invalid Email Customer" into the customer name field

title: Customer search filters the customer list results
description: Verifies the customer list search reduces results to matching customers and displays filtered content.

steps.description: Click the "Customers" link in the Sales module navigation
Type "Test" into the customer search field

title: Customer search with no matches shows an empty-state message
description: Verifies searching for a non-existent customer shows a no-results/empty-state message in the list UI.

steps.description: Click the "Customers" link in the Sales module navigation
Type "ZZZ-NO-SUCH-CUSTOMER-123" into the customer search field
Verify text "No customers found" is visible

title: Create a new product and generate a barcode from the product list
description: Verifies a user can create a product, see it in the product list, and generate a barcode.

steps.description: Click "Inventory" in the main navigation menu
Type "E2E Test Product" into the product name field
Select the first available option from the product category dropdown
Verify text "E2E Test Product" is visible
Click the "Generate barcode" action for the product "E2E Test Product"

title: Product creation validation: SKU is required
description: Verifies that saving a product without a SKU shows a visible validation error.

steps.description: Click "Inventory" in the main navigation menu
Type "SKU Missing Product" into the product name field
Select the first available option from the product category dropdown
Verify text "SKU is required" is visible

title: Filter products by category from product list
description: Verifies selecting a category filter updates the visible product list.

steps.description: Click "Inventory" in the main navigation menu
Select the first available non-empty option from the category filter dropdown

title: Product list loads and shows core UI controls (search, filters, create)
description: Verifies the product list page renders and exposes the expected primary controls for management.

steps.description: Click "Inventory" in the main navigation menu
Verify element "Create new product" is visible

title: Complete a POS sale with cart updates, discount, payment, and receipt print
description: Verifies a cashier can open a POS session, add products, edit quantities, apply an order discount, take payment, complete the sale, and access receipt printing.

steps.description: Click the "POS" option from the main navigation menu

title: Add products to cart and adjust line quantity in POS cart
description: Verifies products can be found and added to the cart and that line quantities can be increased or edited from within the cart.

steps.description: Click the "POS" option from the main navigation menu
Type "test" into the product search field
Verify element "Product search results list" is visible

title: Apply an order-level discount in POS and verify discounted total is shown
description: Verifies applying a discount updates the displayed order totals in the POS screen.

steps.description: Click the "POS" option from the main navigation menu

title: Select a payment method and complete a POS sale
description: Verifies selecting a payment method allows checkout and produces a visible sale confirmation/receipt view.

steps.description: Click the "POS" option from the main navigation menu
Verify element "Payment methods list" is visible
Select "Cash" from the payment methods list

title: Attempt to complete sale without payment method shows validation error
description: Verifies POS prevents checkout when no payment method is selected and displays the expected validation message.

steps.description: Click the "POS" option from the main navigation menu
Verify text "Select payment method" is visible

title: Print receipt after completing sale (in-app receipt screen visible)
description: Verifies the POS provides a receipt screen and a print action after a successful sale completion.

steps.description: Click the "POS" option from the main navigation menu

title: Hold an order and verify it appears in held orders list
description: Verifies a cart can be placed on hold and becomes visible in the held orders area for later recall.

steps.description: Click the "POS" option from the main navigation menu
Click the "Hold" or "Add to Hold" button
Verify element "Held orders list" is visible

title: Create a new warehouse and verify it appears in the warehouse list
description: Verifies an authenticated user can create a warehouse and see it listed in Warehouse Management.

steps.description: Type "Test Warehouse A" into the warehouse name field
Verify text "Test Warehouse A" is visible

title: Validate required fields when creating a warehouse (save blocked with errors)
description: Verifies warehouse creation shows validation errors when required fields are missing.

steps.description: Verify text "This field is required" is visible

title: Create a new purchase order and receive goods to update stock
description: Verifies a user can create a purchase order, receive it, and observe that stock reflects the received quantities.

steps.description: Click the "Purchases" module in the main navigation

title: Create purchase order with supplier and at least one item
description: Verifies purchase order creation succeeds when supplier and line items are provided.

steps.description: Click the "Purchases" module in the main navigation
Select a supplier from the supplier dropdown

title: Submit purchase order after adding product items and quantities
description: Verifies the purchase order can be submitted successfully after adding at least one product item with quantity.

steps.description: Click the "Purchases" module in the main navigation
Select a supplier from the supplier dropdown

title: Receive purchased goods from a submitted purchase order
description: Verifies a submitted purchase order can be received and shows a received/completed status in the UI.

steps.description: Click the "Purchases" module in the main navigation
Click the first purchase order in the list

title: Verify stock updated after receiving goods by checking product list quantities
description: Verifies inventory reflects increased on-hand stock after receiving a purchase order.

steps.description: Click the "Inventory" module in the main navigation

title: Validation error when submitting purchase order with empty supplier
description: Verifies the form blocks submission and shows a visible validation error when Supplier is not selected.

title: View purchase order list and verify key columns are visible
description: Verifies the purchase order list loads and shows expected list content for user navigation.

steps.description: Click the "Purchases" module in the main navigation

title: Search purchase orders from list and see filtered results
description: Verifies searching from the purchase order list updates the visible list results.

steps.description: Click the "Purchases" module in the main navigation

title: Filter purchase orders by status from list view
description: Verifies applying a status filter updates the list to show only matching orders.

steps.description: Click the "Purchases" module in the main navigation
Select "Received" from the status filter dropdown

title: Browse storefront catalog and open a product details page
description: Verifies a guest user can browse the public catalog and open a product details page from the storefront.

steps.description: Scroll to the product list section
Verify at least one product card is visible
Click on the first visible product in the list
Verify a product details section is visible
Verify an "Add to cart" button is visible

title: Search for products from the storefront catalog
description: Verifies search narrows the catalog results based on a query.

steps.description: Verify the product list section is visible

title: Filter catalog by a category from the storefront
description: Verifies selecting a category filter updates the catalog results shown to the user.

steps.description: Select the first non-empty option from the category dropdown
Wait for the catalog results to update
Verify the product list section is visible

title: View product details then add product to cart
description: Verifies a guest user can open a product page and add the item to the cart.

steps.description: Verify at least one product card is visible
Click on the first visible product in the list
Verify an "Add to cart" button is visible
Verify a cart item row is visible

title: Proceed to checkout from cart (guest) and see checkout page
description: Verifies a guest user can proceed from cart to the checkout screen.

steps.description: Click on the first visible product in the list
Verify a shipping address section is visible

title: Checkout validation: missing shipping address shows required error
description: Verifies checkout form validation prevents completion when shipping address is empty and shows the expected error message.

steps.description: Click on the first visible product in the list
Verify text "Shipping address required" is visible

title: Complete an end-to-end guest checkout with valid shipping details
description: Verifies a guest user can add an item to cart, enter shipping details, and complete the checkout flow to an order confirmation state.

steps.description: Click on the first visible product in the list
Type "123 Test Street, Test City" into the shipping address field

title: Category filter flow: apply category and verify catalog remains browseable
description: Verifies that after applying a category filter, the user can still open a product from the filtered results.

steps.description: Select the first non-empty option from the category dropdown
Wait for the catalog results to update
Verify at least one product card is visible
Click on the first visible product in the list
Verify a product details section is visible
Verify an "Add to cart" button is visible

title: Create a new user, assign roles/permissions, then edit the user profile successfully
description: Verifies an admin can create a user with roles/permissions and later edit the same user profile from the user list.

steps.description: Click on "Users" in the main navigation/menu

title: Save a newly created user and confirm it appears in the Users list
description: Verifies that saving a new user persists it and shows it in the /users/ list view.

steps.description: Click on "Users" in the main navigation/menu

title: Assign roles and permissions during user creation and verify they are shown after save
description: Verifies roles/permissions can be assigned on create and are visible on the saved user profile.

steps.description: Click on "Users" in the main navigation/menu
Select a role from the Roles section (choose any available role)

description: Verifies an admin can open a user from the list, edit profile details, save, and see the updated values on reload.

steps.description: Click on "Users" in the main navigation/menu
Click on the first user in the list to open the user profile/edit page

title: Deactivate a user account from the Users list and verify status becomes inactive
description: Verifies an admin can deactivate a user and the UI reflects inactive status in the list or profile.

steps.description: Click on "Users" in the main navigation/menu
Click on the first user in the list to open the user profile/edit page

title: Confirm deactivation persists and user is shown as inactive after saving
description: Verifies that after deactivation, saving (if required) updates the status and it remains inactive when returning to the list.

steps.description: Click on "Users" in the main navigation/menu
Click on the first user in the list to open the user profile/edit page
Click the "Back to Users" or "Users" breadcrumb/link
